skill: M07 裂地重踏 v2 (stronger side-lock wording after walk v1 turned)

parameters.prompt: 2D side-scrolling game sprite animation, orthographic side view. The exact brown bear warrior in the reference performs ONE heavy ground stomp in place. From the resting pose it slowly lifts the front leg high with the knee bent and spreads the arm for balance, then slams the foot down hard, the whole body dropping into a low wide stance, holds the low impact pose briefly, then straightens and calmly returns to the exact original standing pose and holds it. The body orientation is LOCKED in a strict profile facing LEFT for every frame: head, muzzle, chest, belly and toes always point to the left edge, the chest and belly are never shown to the camera, the far arm stays mostly hidden behind the body, the body never rotates or turns. Keep the same bear head, rounded ears, brown fur, shoulder armor, bracer, round belt buckle and leather kilt, same proportions. It stays at the same spot and size and does not move across the frame. Exactly two arms and two legs. Fixed camera, no camera movement, fixed size, pure uniform bright green #00FF00 background. The whole body stays inside the frame with clear margins at all times. No turning, no three-quarter view, no facing the camera, jumping, punch, extra limbs, weapon, glow, energy, dust, rocks, cracks, particles, shadow or text. Motion beats: first second and a half lift the leg, a sudden stomp around two seconds, then recover and hold the original pose.
